$comment: Orchestration system config (migrated from oh-my-opencode-slim + opencode mathematician agent). Edit this file to add/remove agents or change models. See PI-CONFIGURATION.md.

oracle.description: Strategic technical advisor and code reviewer. High-IQ debugging, architecture decisions, code review, simplification. READ-ONLY.

librarian.description: Research specialist for codebases and documentation. Web search, official docs, external repos.

explorer.description: Fast codebase navigation specialist. Answers 'Where is X?', 'Find Y', 'Which file has Z'. READ-ONLY.

designer.description: Frontend UI/UX specialist. Creates and reviews intentional, polished experiences. Always route UI/design work here.

fixer.description: Fast, focused implementation specialist. Executes complete task specs; no research, no design.

observer.description: Visual analysis specialist. Interprets images, screenshots, PDFs and diagrams; extracts structured observations.

observer-math.description: Vision specialist for math PDFs. Converts PDFs to images via pdf2img and extracts every math expression in LaTeX with all symbols preserved.

solver.description: Math problem solver. Applies math-olympiad's adversarial verify cycle for proofs and math-reasoning's derivation templates. Optimised for correctness, not elegance.

writer.description: Math writer. Typst + LaTeX specialist. Renders the verified solution into a clean document and compiles to PDF if a toolchain is available.
